title: The Optimization Landscape of Carath\'eodory Decomposition of Toeplitz Covariances
abstract: arXiv:2511.01605v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Toeplitz covariance estimation is a classical signal processing problem, yet the geometry of the Gaussian maximum-likelihood objective remains only partially understood. Recent Newton-type, majorization-minimization, and gradient-based methods often solve the nonconvex problem globally with enough samples, but also reveal a difficult computational landscape. We study this phenomenon through an overparameterized Carath\'eodory representation, which parameterizes the covariance by the frequencies and amplitudes of steering vectors. A simple example shows that, for any uniform frequency grid, optimizing only the amplitudes can leave a positive error even in the population setting, which motivates optimizing the frequencies as well. Our main result proves that this nonlinear parameterization adds no stationary points: for any sample covariance, every stationary point with a positive definite covariance gives a stationary point of t

translated_title: Toeplitz协方差的Carathéodory分解的优化景观
translated_abstract: Toeplitz协方差估计是一个经典的信号处理问题，然而高斯最大似然目标的几何结构至今仍未被完全理解。近期的牛顿型方法、最大化-最小化方法以及基于梯度的方法在样本充足时通常能够全局求解这一非凸问题，但同时也揭示出一个困难的计算景观。我们通过一种过参数化的Carathéodory表示来研究这一现象，该表示利用导向向量的频率和幅度对协方差进行参数化。一个简单的例子表明，对于任何均匀频率网格，即使在总体（population）情形下，仅优化幅度仍会留下正的误差，这促使我们对频率也进行优化。我们的主要结果证明，这种非线性参数化不会增加驻点：对于任何样本协方差，每一个具有正定协方差的驻点都能给出……的驻点（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 该论文通过对Toeplitz协方差进行过参数化Carathéodory表示（同时优化频率与幅度），证明这种非线性参数化不会引入额外的驻点，从而解释了为何高斯最大似然非凸问题在样本充足时可被全局求解。
en_tdlr: This paper proves that the overparameterized Carathéodory representation of Toeplitz covariances, which optimizes both frequencies and amplitudes, adds no extra stationary points, thereby explaining why the nonconvex Gaussian maximum-likelihood problem can often be solved globally with enough samples.
